d:
In an exclusive podcast with Aaj Tak, senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan launched a sharp attack on AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) president Chandrashekhar Azad ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Questioning Owaisi's decision to contest all 403 seats in UP while struggling to win four MLAs in Hyderabad, Khan implicitly labeled him a BJP agent and claimed he had been sent to the state with a specific agenda.
